# `hk mcp`

- **Usage:** `hk mcp [--root <PATH>]`

Run an MCP server for coding agents over standard input/output

## Flags

- **`--root <PATH>`** — Restrict hk tools to this project root (defaults to the current directory)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Start the STDIO MCP server with a fixed project root. Configure your host to launch this command.

```sh
hk mcp --root /absolute/path/to/project
```
